digest.component_or_area: rebar search command and CLI output formatting
propositions: rebar search currently returns full ticket bodies including complete descriptions and all comment bodies instead of projected discovery summaries
search results lack an --output flag to control format (json vs llm) and --full option for legacy full-state retrieval
default search output must be pruned to eight discovery fields (ticket_id, alias, title, ticket_type, status, priority, summary, snippet) with no full description or comments
summary field is derived from stored summaries if present, otherwise from truncated non-empty description (max 240 chars), otherwise null
snippet field contains case-preserving match context (max 240 chars) around the first positive free-text term occurrence, or null for predicate-only/negation-only queries
search queries and filter semantics must remain unchanged; existing predicates, identifiers, sort behavior, and archived-ticket filtering are unaffected
